description.narrative: The proposed programmes for 2024-2027 respond to direct demands by the Kazakh authorities and will build upon the following programmes whose implementation started or that are under preparation in the first phase of the Cooperation Facility:1) a technical assistance programme (EUR 1 million) that currently supports the implementation of the most urgent areas of the EPCA with a focus on sustainable economic growth (including green growth, and in particular support to the implementation of the MoU on Critical Raw Materials, Batteries and Renewable Hydrogen value chains, in complementarity of the regional Prosperity programme), and rule of law;2) three upcoming technical assistance programmes (EUR 8 million) on the EPCA implementation in the areas of i) trade, ii) modernisation of the Emissions Trading System (ETS) and the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) facilitation and ii) rule of law, with focus on the justice system. The specific terms of references for these programmes will be finalised in the second half of 2024 and the programmes will be operational by mid-2025.For the period 2024-2027, the new programme on Trade and sustainable economic growth will also contribute to the implementation of the regional Global Gateway flagship programmes on critical raw materials and on the development of the Trans-Caspian Transport Corridor (TCTC). The bilateral programme will thus complement the consistent regional programmes covering these flagship sectors, of which Kazakhstan fully benefits. The programme will also focus on the improvement of the business climate for EU investments, which is key for the smooth implementation of all four Global Gateway flagship programmes in Central Asia (on Water, Energy and Climate Change, on Digital Connectivity, on CRM and on the TCTC).The programme focusing on supporting the Kazakh Government¿s efforts to comply with its international obligations (the Global Methane Pledge, the Paris Agreement and other relevant international frameworks) in the areas of climate change, energy and environment protection will contribute directly to the regional Global Gateway flagship project on Water, Energy and Climate Change.The programme on the Enhancement of rule of law and support to decentralisation reforms will strengthen the capacities of institutions that ensure the respect of the rule of law, such as the Constitutional Court of Kazakhstan. Fight against corruption will also be supported under this component, as well as constitutional reforms on decentralisation. Thus, rule of law and legal frames, enablers for the implementation of Global Gateway initiatives, will be strengthened.
